targets.rawSql: SELECT provider, if(empty(window_name), '(default)', window_name) AS window, formatReadableTimeDelta(toUInt64(argMax(window_seconds, observed_at))) AS duration, round(argMax(remaining_percent, observed_at), 1) AS remaining_percent, round(argMax(used_percent, observed_at), 1) AS used_percent, formatReadableTimeDelta(toUInt64(argMax(reset_seconds, observed_at))) AS resets_in, formatDateTime(max(observed_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS last_observed_at FROM aiquota.aiquota_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) GROUP BY provider, window_name, window_seconds ORDER BY provider, window_seconds, window_name

panels.title: Current quota by provider and window

targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at AS time, remaining_percent AS value, concat(provider, ' / ', if(empty(window_name), '(default)', window_name), ' / ', formatReadableTimeDelta(toUInt64(window_seconds))) AS metric FROM aiquota.aiquota_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Quota remaining by provider and window

targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at, source, status_code, content_type, raw_body_size_bytes, raw_body_truncated, error, raw_body_sha256 FROM aiquota.raw_http_observations WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 200
